entities.name: Conqueror's Foothold
entities.description: A Legion of Dusk fortress and prison on mainland Ixalan, where captives are executed to sustain vampiric rituals.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire conquistadors who colonize Ixalan and may only feed on the blood of their foes.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: Vampire conquistador who commanded the Foothold and sought the Hierophant's Chalice.

entities.name: Adrian Adanto
entities.description: Established the Foothold with the Legion of Dusk during their colonial campaigns.

entities.name: Alante
entities.description: Vampire cleric of the Order of the Five Sacraments who betrayed Vona, freed the prisoners and secured the Chalice.

entities.name: Order of the Five Sacraments
entities.description: A vampire sect favoring trade with the Sun Empire over subjugation.

entities.name: Hierophant's Chalice
entities.description: An artifact said to create an endless supply of blood.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: Temple where the Chalice was found.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the Foothold stands.

entities.name: Apostasine Wars
entities.description: Wars in which Vona forged her brutal reputation.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Land conquered by the Legion, in which Vona took part.

events.summary: Vona joined the first fleet to Ixalan and established the Foothold as a stronghold for her own ambitions.
events.quote: Vona joined the first fleet to cross the sea to Ixalan .

events.summary: Vona discovered a map to the Hierophant's Chalice and used the Foothold and its prisoners to search for it.
events.quote: Vona discovered a map leading to the Hierophant's Chalice, an artifact said to create an endless supply of blood.

events.summary: Alante turned against Vona, stole the map, freed the prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz, securing the Chalice for her order.
events.quote: Stealing the map, she freed the doomed prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz ahead of Vona’s forces, ultimately securing the Chalice for her order and thwarting Vona’s plan.

relations.note: commanded it until she left for Orazca
relations.quote: Until she left for Orazca , Conqueror's Foothold was commanded by Vona de Iedo
As a conquistador, she established the Foothold as a stronghold
Alante , a vampire cleric of the Order of the Five Sacraments
Alante secretly turned against Vona after learning of her plot.

relations.note: established by Adanto and the Legion
relations.quote: Conqueror's Foothold is a fortified outpost established by Adrian Adanto and the Legion of Dusk
